narrative.overview: The recovered Godot game is the visual authority: HD-2D scenery, animated pixel characters, original title, music and white/ink menus. Mobile controls extend its existing touch system.
keyCharacteristics: Original pixel characters in a lit three-dimensional world.
Paper windows and translucent combat overlays.
Contextual touch controls around a visible landscape playfield.

rules.name: The Semantic Meter Rule
rules.body: HP is green above half, amber above one fifth, and red otherwise; PP keeps its own blue.

rules.name: The Bounded Touch Scale Rule
rules.body: Retain the source scale range of 1.0–1.8. At the verified 844×390 engine viewport, Menu reaches at least 48px, small actions 52px and moves 60px. The cap means these are not universal physical-size guarantees; phone ergonomics require device review.

dos: Do preserve supplied assets, world visibility, original Credits and demo boundaries.
Do retain original fonts, window construction and semantic meters.
Do verify touch dimensions in engine screen pixels and separately review physical-device ergonomics.
donts: Don't replace this game with Emerald/Empress UI or add marketing panels around active play.
Don't treat Compatibility rendering as exact desktop lighting parity.
